constraints: If numRecords is omitted, the command retrieves only the current record from the data source (for use in a loop that receives one record at a time).

overloadMerges.note: restored the documented sentinel value on numRecords (the SQL All Records constant, value -1, meaning "retrieve all records of the table") which autoparse's mechanical param draft has no field for.

sentinelValues.meaning: SQL All Records constant: retrieve all records of the table.
